quarterly_data.signal: Digital Realty started construction of ZUR4 in Glattbrugg, expanding its Zurich-area campus: 15 megawatts (MW) of IT capacity across approximately 6,300 square metres, designed for high-density deployments and AI workloads; completion is planned for 2028. Managing Director Yves Zischek also cited the ongoing construction of FRA20 in Frankfurt and VIE13 in Vienna, and said the campus connects more than 200 customers on-site.
